title: Personalize Valentine proposal text for Hina and match HTML title

requirements.text: Update the proposal question text on the Valentine proposal card to match the provided HTML: show the recipient name as "Hina" followed by a comma, then a line break, then the text "will you be my Valentine?".
acceptanceCriteria: The card headline renders exactly as two lines: "Hina," on the first line and "will you be my Valentine?" on the second line.
No other user-facing text is changed as part of this requirement.

requirements.text: Set the browser tab title to exactly "Be My Valentine 💘" to match the provided HTML title.
acceptanceCriteria: The document/page title shown in the browser tab is exactly "Be My Valentine 💘".

constraints: Frontend code must not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not add additional canisters.
nonGoals: Adding new screens or flows beyond updating the displayed recipient name and the page title.
Changing confetti behavior, sound effect URLs, button dodge behavior, or floating hearts behavior (these are already implemented).
Adding backend persistence or user accounts.
